overview_description.description: Lumachain brings transparency to global supply chains, benefitting producers, enterprises, and consumers. Lumachain's platform tracks and traces the origin, location, and condition of individual items in a supply chain, in real-time, from farm to fork. This incentivizes farmers and manufacturers to create high-quality products. It allows enterprises to reduce waste, increase efficiency, and grow revenues and margins. It also allows consumers to know the condition and quality of what they buy, and that it has been ethically and sustainably sourced.

about_short_description.short_description: Lumachain is a supply chain platform designed for tracking the origin, condition, and location of items in the food supply chain.

product.name: Computer Vision AI Platform
product.description: An AI-driven system using cameras and algorithms to monitor and analyze food processing operations for safety, quality, and efficiency.

product.name: Traceability Platform
product.description: A system providing end-to-end real-time tracking of food products from origin through processing to end customers.

product.name: Quality Control Checks Platform
product.description: A tablet-based digital system for plant floor employees to follow SOPs and capture production, quality, and safety data accurately.

product.name: Dispatcher Platform
product.description: A platform for managing last-mile delivery operations, providing real-time fleet and delivery visibility for distribution centers.

product.name: Animal Welfare Monitoring Platform
product.description: An AI-based system using computer vision to monitor and assess animal welfare in meat processing facilities.

product.name: Modules for Bottling Plants
product.description: AI-powered modules tailored for bottling plants to monitor packaging, detect foreign objects, ensure process compliance, and enhance employee safety.
